name: RankAI
author: Kunal Parihar

sections.description:
RankAI is a next-generation SEO plugin that not only optimizes your posts for search engines but also ensures your content is easily found and cited by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude.

Why RankAI?
– Traditional SEO focuses only on search engines — but AI tools are now a major source of traffic.
– RankAI bridges the gap, ensuring your content is optimized for both search engines and AI-powered discovery.

Key Features:
* Traditional SEO Analysis – Title, meta description, headings, keyword density, content length & more.
* AI-Specific Optimization –
1. AI-Friendly Content Structure Analysis
2. Citation and Source Authority Optimization
3. Semantic Keyword & Context Optimization
* Real-Time Analysis – Works in the post/page editor as you write.
* Visual Scoring System – Clear scores for each metric with actionable tips.
* Actionable Recommendations – Specific steps to improve both SEO & AI discoverability.

Use Cases:
– Bloggers who want more visibility in AI responses.
– Businesses aiming for organic traffic from search and AI citations.
– Content creators focused on authority and expertise.

How it Works:
When you create or update a post/page, RankAI analyzes your content, scores it across multiple SEO and AI readiness metrics, and provides clear improvement suggestions — all inside WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rankai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit any post or page — you’ll see the RankAI metabox with your scores.
  4. Enter your target keyword and meta description.
  5. Click Analyze with RankAI — review your scores and follow recommendations.
sections.faq:
Does RankAI work with all themes?

Yes. RankAI works independently of your theme and analyzes only your post/page content.

Does it replace Yoast SEO or RankMath?

No — it can work alongside them, adding AI optimization features those plugins don’t provide.

Will RankAI slow down my site?

No — all analysis runs in the admin editor, not on the live frontend.

Is my content sent to an external server?

No — analysis is processed locally inside your WordPress site.

Can I export scores or reports?

Currently, scores are stored in your database and visible in the editor. Export features are planned for future versions.
